title: Transparent Firework Trails
description: Makes firework rockets' trails almost invisible while flying on an elytra
body:
This mod makes trails from firework rockets while flying on an elytra almost invisible; it does so by simply rendering 35% of all particles the firework rocket produces. This mod could be useful to those who want to play with particles, but the fireworks just make too many of them, ig.
- Use v1.0.0 if you want the particles gone everywhere while you are flying.
- Use v1.1.0 if you want the particles gone only at the bottom of your feet when you stop gliding.
